ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) focal points; estimated ratio of high-to-low intensity pixels is approximately 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white circular spots across the dark ventral surface; primary clusters are located in the mid-left field and along the vertical axis of the fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees; notch vertex is clearly defined and centered between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge with triangular peaks (10-25 pixels in height) and localized deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the notch to the distal tips; lobes exhibit an upward-lateral sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity clusters (5-20 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes, likely healed attachment sites of sessile organisms.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear streaks visible; one prominent diagonal mark on the right lobe and horizontal scratches on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular truncation/notch on the distal margin of the left lobe; multiple parallel rake-mark scars visible on the central-right surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in tip morphology; the left tip exhibits a jagged, truncated profile while the right tip (partially visible) appears more tapered.
